## Zig 0.16.0 compiler_rt and libunwind

The binary is linked with Zig (cargo-zigbuild, glibc floor 2.31). Zig links its compiler_rt into the binary; compiler_rt provides math functions that the binary does not import from glibc (ceil, floor, fmod, trunc and others, which the QuickJS-ng engine calls). compiler_rt is under Zig's MIT License (Expat; zig-0.16.0/LICENSE in https://ziglang.org/download/0.16.0/zig-0.16.0.tar.xz (sha256 43186959edc87d5c7a1be7b7d2a25efffd22ce5807c7af99067f86f99641bfdf in https://ziglang.org/download/index.json)):

Zig also links LLVM libunwind into the binary (Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception; the exception needs no notice for code embedded in object form).

## glibc

The binary links the GNU C Library dynamically (libc.so.6, libm.so.6; glibc 2.31 or later). The small glibc start files and libc_nonshared code that the link adds are under the GNU Lesser General Public License 2.1 or later with the exception that gives unlimited permission to link the compiled files into other programs.

## Embedded JavaScript (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-browser-host/js)

bin/cmux-browser-host embeds its runtime JavaScript (every file of js/manifest.json). These files are third-party code; the rest is cmux's own code (GPL-3.0-or-later, LICENSE):

- `vendor/acorn.js`: acorn 8.16.0 (https://github.com/acornjs/acorn), dist/acorn.js unmodified (MIT)
- `vendor/playwright-injected.js`: Playwright (playwright-core 1.57.0, https://github.com/microsoft/playwright), lib/generated/injectedScriptSource.js: the evaluated source string, unmodified (Apache-2.0)
- `vendor/playwright-locator-utils.js`: Playwright (playwright-core 1.57.0, https://github.com/microsoft/playwright), lib/utils/isomorphic/locatorUtils.js and the escape helpers of stringUtils.js; functions unchanged, module wrapper changed (stated in the file header) (Apache-2.0)
